CauseWay’s role: CauseWay develops and maintains this resource. It is responsible for how the evidence is organised and linked, for its own synthesis, documented derivations and editorial analysis, and for correcting errors.

CauseWay is a Yemeni institutional advisory firm based in Aden (Commercial Registration No. 26666). It works with financial institutions, public institutions and development partners where finance, governance, regulation and implementation meet. Some of those institutions publish evidence used in this resource. That evidence is selected and presented by the method published here, and every record can be checked against the sources it names and corrected through the published route.

Funding. CauseWay funded the development of this edition entirely from its own resources. No donor, regulator, source institution or external commissioning party funded it. This resource is not a deliverable of any contract or partnership with the institutions whose data it presents.

Who remains authoritative: Original publishers remain authoritative for the data and publications they issue. Organising the evidence does not make CauseWay a regulator, statistical authority or source owner. This resource does not confirm whether any named institution is currently licensed or operating. Nothing on this resource is financial, legal or regulatory advice, or confirmation of any institution’s current status. Attribution to CauseWay covers only its own synthesis, derivations and analysis and does not imply that any original publisher endorses them. Citation, factual use and redistribution are separate permissions.

How to check or challenge: Each figure is recorded in an evidence record that names its original source wherever that source can be named publicly. Material findings are checked against the source they are attributed to, including its unit, population or calculation base, geography, period and method; a figure known only from a secondary source is labelled as secondary. To report a suspected error, write to office@causewaygrp.com with the record or source reference. When a material public conclusion changes, the evidence record and a correction note are updated together.
